content.title: ESC Committee for Practice Guidelines 2018-2020 - Declarations of Interest
content.note: The report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by the experts during the yearly call for declaration conducted every January covering the previous calendar year. Calls for declaration are conducted during the period of development of these guidelines up to and including 2019.
